sources.quote: Senator Blumenthal files his annual disclosure by paper, as do a number of his colleagues.
sources.searcher_note: Names Blumenthal as a paper filer, but of his ANNUAL disclosure, not his periodic transaction (stock-trade) reports; 2019 report, before the lead's window. Spokesperson says the PDF is readable when zoomed.
Ranks Blumenthal #1 in Congress for 2025 trading: Total Trades 406, Total Volume $79.83 million (Capitol Trades data). Shows outside trackers do transcribe his paper PTRs; silent on paper filing.

sources.quote: The forms are not always text searchable, and some members file handwritten (and occasionally illegible) reports.
sources.searcher_note: Pattern: members filing handwritten, non-searchable disclosure reports. No senator named.

notes: No source found says Blumenthal files his stock-trade (PTR) reports on paper, or gives the 69-of-69 count or the 43-of-44 Senate paper filings since 2024. Closest: Roll Call 2020 on his paper ANNUAL disclosure. Common Cause (Dec 2025) and trackers (Capitol Trades, Quiver, Unusual Whales) list his trades, so his paper filings are transcribed elsewhere; the lead's claim is only that this warehouse holds none. A search snippet quoted Common Cause via X (Betsy McCaughey) that he made 406 trades worth nearly $80 million in 2025; not recorded separately. The Drill Down (2022-02-11) covers a late Blumenthal PTR (Robinhood sale disclosed after 56 days), a different finding, not recorded. Capitol Trades page returned 429; Quiver page renders no data. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found.
